notes: First-person gunplay against AI bots is Shooter, but no preset survives contact with this prompt: the answers strip out rounds, the bomb and every other Counter-Strike objective, which kills Bomb Defusal, and the closest remaining row, PvE Shooter, would lose both its shape and all but spawner-npc, so I built it from scratch rather than keep a name that no longer describes it. volume-open-air is the shape because the prompt insists the play space is a true cubic volume with surfaces at every depth rather than a ground plane with elevation, and the answers size vertical depth to match width and length. That volume self-occludes by construction, so the CHECK its row carries is genuinely live rather than the usual play-height envelope — worth flagging that CHECK is not on the proven pipeline today. Simple polygon geometry doubles as the sightline-breaking cover, bots respawning at random points are spawner-npc, and the lone player's entry point is spawn-protected.
